lines: Amit Arun Dixit, a Promoter, holds shares that unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 67 days ago, with no cash received yet.
Shares worth ₹168.32 crore (estimate, valued at offer price) unlocked on 9 Sep 2026; the minimum promoter contribution stays locked until 9 Sep 2027.
Shares tied to the minimum promoter contribution stay locked until 9 Sep 2027, so more of their holding becomes sellable later. Ashwini Amit Dixit shares the surname and a family link.
